preprocess_superpoint_images: preprocess a batch of images for SuperPoint keypoint detection with grayscale conversion and resizing
post_process_keypoint_detection: post-process SuperPoint model outputs to extract keypoints, scores, and descriptors in original image coordinates
convert_to_grayscale: convert RGB images to 3-channel grayscale format using the NTSC formula

group_images_by_shape: group images by their spatial dimensions for efficient batched processing in SuperPoint preprocessing
